encoding/bytes#

Parsing primitives over byte values: search and range views that read the bytes in place, without slicing them into new arrays first.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let frame is @byte = ...; // "VALUE key 0 5\r\nhello\r\n"
let eol is int = ByteSearch(source: frame, pattern: Utf8Encoded("\r\n").bytes()).from(0);
let space is int = ByteSearch(source: frame, pattern: [byte(32)]).from(10);
let size is int = ByteRange(source: frame, start: space + 1, end: eol).decimal();      // 5
let value is string = ByteRange(source: frame, start: eol + 2, end: eol + 2 + size).text();

Description#

Parsing primitives over byte values: search and range views that read the bytes in place, without slicing them into new arrays first.

Offsets are byte offsets into the source. A range is start..end, end excluded. InvalidUtf8 and InvalidByteDecimal report offsets relative to the range start, as if the range were decoded on its own.

Errors#

enum InvalidByteDecimal#

enum InvalidByteDecimal is Error = (at(offset is int))

The first byte at which a range stops being an ASCII decimal integer (optional leading '-', then at least one digit 0-9). An empty range, or a lone '-', fails at its end.
